title: Figure 2: Relative Motion of UFO System – hand-plotted motion traces, "Utah" film
description: Hand-drawn dotted traces with direction arrows showing the relative motion of objects in the 1952 "Utah" film. Part a) shows four looping arc traces at "0.25 Second Interval, 0.01 Radians/Inch" with a marked "Reference Object for a.)"; part b) shows a short irregular trace at "1.00 Second Interval, 0.02 Radians/Inch" with a "Reference Object for b.)". The page is from "Photogrammetric Analysis of 'Utah' Film," page 8, Serial 02.
